name: web-ui
description: Web UI skills from Anthropic's Apache-2.0 skills repository: frontend-design (persona-free copy) and webapp-testing.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
